## Lease and attempt discipline

Before every lease, coordinators reconcile stale assignments, current issue and
tracker bodies, main, source, branch, checkout, and GitHub state. Issue and
tracker synchronization precede the final read-only Astra scope and lease.
Each lease names issue `#705`, attempt, phase, executor, immutable checkout and
commit, tracker, main, source, exact commands, and release marker. A separate
release marker is written only after terminal acknowledgement. The executor
checks that no release or revocation exists before every command.

Every shell call uses the exact absolute detached worktree, `login:true`, and
prints cwd, HEAD, literal `upstream=not-applicable-detached`, and status before
assertions. Never invoke `@{upstream}` in a detached checkout; upstream parity
applies only to preparation and overlay branches. Use direct commands
with real exit propagation; no custom runner, unconditional-success wrapper,
fabricated status, retry, or polling that hides a result. A preflight, setup,
launch, assertion, evidence, or qualification failure consumes the attempt even
if no workload or root was created. Review and overlay pauses remain in the
same attempt. Use fresh numbered roots for each later attempt; three failures
hard-stop with no fourth attempt.

Fresh Attempt 1 roots must be absent, including dangling symlinks, before Sol
prepares E1 and before execution begins:

```text
/tmp/cp1-pdc-artifact-705-a1-probe-evidence
/tmp/cp1-pdc-artifact-705-a1-probe-tmp
/tmp/cp1-pdc-artifact-705-a1-probe-output
/tmp/cp1-pdc-artifact-705-a1-probe-target
/tmp/cp1-pdc-artifact-705-a1-qualify-evidence
/tmp/cp1-pdc-artifact-705-a1-qualify-tmp
/tmp/cp1-pdc-artifact-705-a1-artifact
/tmp/cp1-pdc-artifact-705-a1-qualify-target
/tmp/cp1-pdc-artifact-705-a1-hermetic-target
```

Attempts 2 and 3 substitute their attempt number in every root. The executor
must durably record ordinary absence and dangling-symlink absence separately,
then create only the assigned evidence/tmp/output directories in the required
order. No target or artifact directory is created before its command owns it.
Capture full argv, inherited and explicit environment, cwd, head, upstream,
dirty state, UTC times, stdout, stderr, actual result, persistent-session
launch, each real poll receipt, and a finite self-excluding manifest. A status
file containing `0` is never execution authority.

tracker are synchronized, all tools are executable, no relevant process exists,

  TMPDIR=/tmp/cp1-pdc-artifact-705-a1-probe-tmp \
  CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/cp1-pdc-artifact-705-a1-probe-target \
